net_worth.label: Net value
net_worth.explain: Net liquidation of the main account (broker NetLiquidation, USD), from the latest capture.

day_change.label: Previous trading day
day_change.explain: Net liquidation of the latest capture minus the previous captured trading day, USD; includes deposits and withdrawals, not pure return. The percentage is this change divided by the previous day.

month_to_date.label: Month to date
month_to_date.explain: Net liquidation of the latest capture minus the last trading day of the previous month, USD; includes deposits and withdrawals, not time-weighted return.

cash.label: Cash
cash.explain: Cash of the main account (TotalCashValue, USD). The large figure is the share of net value, the small one the amount; negative cash is margin borrowing.
